beats.headline: Suárez scored [twice] vs Man United. Not [that one].
beats.vo: Luis Suárez just scored twice against Manchester United. Not that one.

beats.headline: [3] penalties. [2] goals ruled out.
beats.vo: The craziest match you'll ever see: three penalties, two disallowed goals, a divot, a red card.

beats.headline: 30': [penalty] to Sporting.
beats.vo: Thirty minutes: penalty to Sporting. Suárez hits it down the middle. Lammens saves it.

beats.headline: Lammens [bundles] him. Penalty [two].
beats.vo: Then Lammens charges out and bundles Araújo. Second penalty. Suárez scores this one.

beats.headline: 40': Amad scores. [Whistle] first.
beats.vo: Forty minutes: Amad scores, but the referee had already blown. ESPN says too early, so VAR couldn't look.

beats.headline: 48': [Bruno] scores. 1–1.
beats.vo: Second half: Martínez wins a penalty. Bruno Fernandes, Sporting's old star, scores.

beats.headline: 50': Bruno [again].
beats.vo: Two minutes later, Bruno again. His shot hits a divot and flies over the keeper.

beats.headline: 80': [Suárez] again. 2–2.
beats.vo: Eightieth minute: Lammens goes for a high ball, Suárez nudges him, and scores. Two–two.

beats.headline: 82': own goal. [VAR] says no.
beats.vo: Then Sporting's keeper flaps at a corner and scores an own goal. VAR rules it out: Dorgu fouled him. Tielemans, already booked, is sent off.

beats.headline: [11] shots to [7].
beats.vo: Sporting had eleven shots, United seven. Sporting's keeper made no saves.

beats.headline: United: [19th]. Three games left.
beats.vo: United took a point and dropped two places. Nineteenth, three games left.

beats.headline: Were the [officials] fair?
beats.vo: Pochettino's second game, still no win. Brentford on Saturday. Were the officials fair?
